messages:
Maya R: Hey finance — account 'redwood-corp' was suspended this morning due to unpaid invoice  INV-2026-089. Customer says they already submitted PO#PC-7789 and that VAT should be reversed. They're upset, asking for immediate reinstatement. Logged ticket: https://zendesk.company/tickets/6421
Samir K: Can you paste the invoice and transaction IDs? I only see a failed charge attempt: txn_3KQ4yZ (card_declined / code: card_declined). No retries after 3 attempts.
Maya R: Invoice INV-2026-089, amount EUR 12,450. Transaction txn_3KQ4yZ (2026-03-02 04:12 UTC). Customer claim: PO attached to the support message (PO: PC-7789) + EU VAT ID GB999999973.
Priya S: If they provided a valid EU VAT ID and are B2B, VAT should be reverse-charged and zero-rated. Looks like billing applied VAT by default. We need a corrected invoice without VAT and mark the PO on the invoice. Also the customer requested payment via PO/net-30 rather than card.
Samir K: Ok. Two parallel actions: 1) STOP further dunning & revert suspension while we confirm PO. 2) Re-issue corrected invoice (credit memo + new invoice) and arrange manual payment terms. Can we hold the account in "collections hold" state but keep service active?
Jason L: I can flip the flag. Running admin command now:
```
# admin console
admin update-account --org redwood-corp --set hold_dunning=true --set service_suspended=false --note "Hold while PO PC-7789 verified; awaiting corrected invoice" 
```
I'll push within 10m. Will also disable automated dunning emails for this org.
BillingBot: Automated action: dunning_disabled for org=redwood-corp by jason.l at 2026-03-02T10:18:20Z.
Priya S: For the tax side: we need customer's VAT validation doc. Maya, can you request their VAT certificate copy and the PO PDF? Once we have that, I'll create credit memo to cancel VAT and generate new invoice with PO# on it.
Maya R: Sent request to customer at 10:22. They replied with PO PDF and VAT cert at 10:33. Uploading to ticket.
Samir K: Great. Priya, after you create corrected invoice can we offer them a manual payment link (wire/ACH) and mark invoice as Net-30? They explicitly refuse card payments going forward.
Priya S: Yes. I'll create credit memo CM-2026-014 and new invoice INV-2026-090 (no VAT, includes PO PC-7789, payment terms Net-30). I'll also set payment method to "manual - PO" so system won't auto-charge card.
Priya S: Doing the corrections now. Note: needs finance manager sign-off for >10k EUR. Tagging @Samir for approval.
Samir K: Approved. Please proceed.
Priya S: Done: CM-2026-014 issued, INV-2026-090 created and emailed to billing@redwood-corp with payment instructions. Set internal note: "PO on file; manual terms".
Maya R: Customer confirms they received the new invoice and will submit the PO internally to AP for payment. They asked for immediate reinstatement while payment processes.
Samir K: Since we have PO and corrected invoice, and we disabled suspension, we can reinstate. Keep a tight watch: enable a 7-day internal follow-up to confirm payment. If not paid, we re-enable suspension.
Jason L: Reinstatement applied: service_suspended=false (effective 2026-03-02T10:40Z). I'll set a follow-up reminder in the ops calendar and add an alert to collections dashboard for INV-2026-090 due 2026-04-01.
BillingBot: Note created in collections: follow-up task ID follow-7832, due 2026-03-09.
Maya R: Customer appreciative, said "thanks for fast turnaround". Closing Zendesk ticket after payment confirmation.
Samir K: Add short postmortem: why was VAT applied when VAT ID present? Priya, can we add a guard in billing validation to check VAT ID on invoice creation and prevent auto-VAT?
Priya S: Yes, filing engineering request RFC-546 to add VAT-ID validation on invoice creation + add PO flag to avoid auto-charge if PO present.
Jason L: I'll take RFC-546, estimate 3 dev-days. Will prioritize after current sprint.
Maya R: Final status: account active, corrected invoice sent, PO on file, follow-up task scheduled. Will update once payment clears. :thumbsup:
